title: Houston Astros Celebrated By Popping Bottles Of 50 Cent's Champagne 'Le Chemin du Roi Brut'
htmlContent:
The Houston Astros have spared no expense to celebrate their World Series title this weekend.
TMZ Sports reported they spent nearly $400,000 on 50 Cent champagne during their post-game party.

Per TMZ, the team unloaded a few more than 250 bottles from rapper Le Chemin du Roi Brut just after finishing the Phillies in Philadelphia on Saturday night to win the Fall Classic.'

In total, there were 250 bottles of Rose, 10 Magnums of the Bubble, and one, huge 15-liter bottle as well. The total invoice was $388,750!

Of course, the 'Stros enjoyed every bottle soaking in it for hours after their 4-1 victory in Houston.

Star pitcher Lance McCuller Jr. seemed to make the best of it all, though, starting with the epic celebration in Houston by smearing his teammates first.

The Astros will continue the party later on Monday -- their championship parade was scheduled for 11 a.m. CT.
